up: Show the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614331. Return the activity type, exact standard value, standard units, standard relation, and canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_type AS activity_type,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614331'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
